name: Chihara Hina
source:
She has a childish personality, but is naturally very shy and quiet. When push comes to shove she can be very aggressive.

She is happy to have an older brother.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=28722]Getchu[/url]]
